subject: Phase 2 enablement - staggered activation & key naming
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@brightleaf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phase 2 enablement — next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. BrightLeaf is ready to start Phase 2: expand Redwood access to three additional product teams (Search, Recommendations, and Billing). We need:
- new API keys scoped per project
- staggered activation across teams (Search first)
- expected steady-state throughput: ~120 qps aggregate, peak bursts to 600 qps for 30s

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm expected lead time to provision keys and set per-key rate limits?
2) We'd like to align on any term changes for adding 3 teams — we anticipate needing 60M tokens/month more and want to understand pricing/commits.

Alex
Product Ops
BrightLeaf

[Attachment: phase2_requirements.docx (docx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phase 2 enablement — next steps

Alex — thanks, this is clear and actionable. Below is a proposed operational cadence and the answers to your asks.

Summary plan (proposed):
1) Provisioning window: 2 business days for key creation + environment scoping once we have project names and primary contacts.
2) Staggered activation: Week 1 (Search canary), Week 2 (Recommendations), Week 3 (Billing).
3) Canary policy: 2 apps (Search) at 10% of projected traffic for 48 hours, validate latency and error budgets, then scale.
4) Rate limits: per-key steady-state quota + burst allowance (we can set burst to 5x steady qps for 30s, then throttle).

Key naming conventions (to keep telemetry clean):
- brightleaf_search_v2_prod
- brightleaf_recs_v1_staging
- brightleaf_billing_v1_prod
(We will expose keys in a per-project CSV template.)

On the commercial side: we should confirm whether the additional 60M tokens/month will be added to your existing committed tier or handled as overage. Ben, can you propose the pricing/commit update?

Next steps I will take this week:
- Attach activation workbook with timeline and the CSV template for keys (see attachment).
- Provision a first Search key once Alex sends the team contact and project slug.
- Schedule a 30-minute kickoff after keys are provisioned.

Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[Attachment: phase2_activation_plan.xlsx (xlsx) — includes timeline & CSV template]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@brightleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-26T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phase 2 enablement — next steps

Alex — quick commercial note. Happy to accommodate the 3-team expansion. Options we can offer: 
A) Add the 60M tokens to your current commit with a 10% price uplift on the incremental band and maintain existing SLA.
B) Add as a separate committed band for the remainder of your term at a 12% uplift but with a 12-month minimum.
C) Run as overage at standard list pricing for 30 days while we validate usage, then convert to option A if volumes stabilize.

Recommend option A to reduce operational churn and lock in predictable unit economics. If BrightLeaf is open to a 12-month amendment we can also extend a small onboarding credit and waive the one-time provisioning fee.

I can draft an addendum (pricing-addendum-BL-2027-089.pdf) and route for approval once you confirm preference.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Enterprise
ben@redwood.com

[Attachment referenced: pricing-addendum-BL-2027-089.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@brightleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-27T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phase 2 enablement — next steps

Hi all — a few technical constraints and recommendations from infra to ensure Phase 2 is smooth:

- KV cache sizing: with the projected 60M tokens/month and the three-per-project key split, we recommend enabling per-key KV eviction policies and reserving a 10% cache partition for Billing to avoid cross-tenant thrash.
- Batching/latency: For Search we will set smaller micro-batches to keep p95 < 120ms; Recs can accept slightly higher latency with larger batches.
- Canary monitoring: we will instrument per-key traces and add an alert set for token-level cost spikes and latency regressions; Naomi will add those to your dashboard.
- API key rotation: suggest default 90-day rotation and allow you to request immediate revocation via ops@redwood.com.

Naming + provisioning automation note:
On Wed, Aug 25, 2027 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole wrote:
> Key naming conventions (to keep telemetry clean):
> - brightleaf_search_v2_prod
> - brightleaf_recs_v1_staging
> - brightleaf_billing_v1_prod

I propose one small change so our tooling handles environment flags more reliably: use a delimiter like "-" instead of underscores for environment tokens, e.g., brightleaf-search-v2-prod. If BrightLeaf is OK with that we'll namespace and generate keys automatically and post the CSV.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Alex Moreno <alex@brightleaf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, ops@brightleaf.com
Date: 2027-08-28T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phase 2 enablement — next steps

Thanks everyone — this looks good. A few confirmations from BrightLeaf: 
- We approve the "-" delimiter for key names (brightleaf-search-v2-prod, etc.).
- We prefer commercial Option A (add tokens to existing commit). Please send the addendum and we'll route it to procurement.
- Ops will send the project slugs and primary contacts by EOD Monday.

Next meeting: Ops suggested Tuesday 09:00 AM PT for a 30-minute kickoff. Can Redwood make that? If yes, include a calendar invite and we'll have procurement on the call to speed sign-off.

Also attached: our CSV template filled with project slugs for your provisioning step.

Alex Moreno
Product Ops, BrightLeaf
alex@brightleaf.com
